blurb: Guests can take horseback riding lessons, enjoy guided trail rides tailored to their experience level, or participate in pony rides for young children. The summer riding camp offers week-long sessions with daily lessons, trail rides, crafts, and a horse show. Horse training services are also available by contacting the farm.
